review_boundary: Exploratory T42 offline tooling only. This review does not authorize T43, select a Breakdown threshold, or establish causal or thesis claims.

accepted_scopes.ejmi_math: Strict registered A/B margins and 120/60/30 persistence logic matched independent boundary fixtures.
accepted_scopes.tier1_matrix: All 81 registered two-seed R/EJMI combinations produced the intended Tier-1 action.
accepted_scopes.tier2_integrity: Only empty or one complete same-q branch is accepted; a complete lower-branch fixture produced 10 registered terminal logical runs, 8 used logical runs, 64 eligible endpoint cells and 6 planned comparisons.

accepted_scopes.contract_and_authorization_lock: Exact arithmetic rules, EJMI constants, immutable registration payload and the complete T43 approval envelope are validated against drift.
accepted_scopes.R_measurement_integrity: Arrival, coverage and duplicate within-frame identity contradictions become unresolved evidence.
accepted_scopes.current_safety_state: T43 remains prohibited, all four start/connect counters are zero, and no new source map exists.
accepted_scopes.references: C17/C23/MH17/MH23 independently matched 36/40/0/0 A-window R events, exact Stage 4 E1 aggregates and all eight unique endpoint cells per run.

recommendation: The repaired T42 package may be submitted to scientific_reviewer. Keep T43 prohibited until a separate, complete, user-approved launch envelope is recorded after review.

The two-seed design remains exploratory and cannot establish robust stochastic or causal conclusions.
EJMI is not a frozen Breakdown or capacity threshold.
